title: Generated SUNSTUDY body recovery profile
scope: CLI disposition for a malformed generated SUNSTUDY body at AC1015 and AC1018, including continuation, strict refusal, and explicit-partial ASCII/Binary output readback.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the local dwg_local_roundtrip test writer and removed by the test runner.
source.profile: One SUNSTUDY with conditional sheet strings, one date pair, three hour flags, range values, plot settings, four non-null resource handles, and a following LINE. A bounded one-bit mutation is selected only after the valid generated object frame is captured and its common prologue parses.

assertions: The valid generated source is read before mutation search.
A bounded one-bit SUNSTUDY body mutation fails that typed object frame while the following LINE remains readable.
Source frames equal published plus failed frames, with exactly one failed object frame and no failed entity frames.
Strict ASCII and Binary conversion refuse atomically and preserve the destination sentinel.
Explicit-partial ASCII and Binary conversion to AC1021 succeeds, preserves the following content, and reopens through the local DXF reader.

validation.dedicated_test: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -V -R '^dwg2dxf_cli_sunstudy_recovery$' passed 1/1 and reported 10 controls.

modern_revision_exclusions.AC1021: The generated scratch baseline fails common-owner role validation: raw handle code 5, reference 0xA603, which is the seeded page-setup handle. No malformed-body mutation profile is admitted from this baseline.
modern_revision_exclusions.AC1024_AC1027_AC1032: Generator eligibility attempts did not produce capturable valid baselines; these revisions are excluded.
modern_revision_exclusions.next_step: Resolve the generated modern source's common/type-specific handle span and role with source or authoritative format evidence before adding modern SUNSTUDY disposition controls.

limits: Generated local CLI recovery evidence only; no producer-authored SUNSTUDY source, native rendering behavior, or external interoperability is qualified.
The profile qualifies AC1015 and AC1018 only and must not be generalized to modern revisions.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed.
